room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 2% of SI per day subject to maximum ₹5,000/day; proportionate deduction applies on associated expenses if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 5% of SI per day subject to maximum ₹10,000/day

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies on every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower; modern/advanced treatments (robotic surgery, etc.) capped at 50% of SI; room rent and ICU also sub-limited

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months per standard exclusion clause, but Table of Benefits states 4 years (48 months) for declared PEDs; 48 months used as per schedule

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for ENT disorders, cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, varicose veins, calculi, etc.; 36-month wait for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of SI added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; maximum 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation/OPD treatment explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses cover in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance expenses covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, consumables and numerous non-medical items explicitly listed under List I as not covered

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly restricted to treatment within India only

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary/OPD treatment, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, war, nuclear/bio/chemical attack, cosmetic surgery, obesity surgery (unless criteria met)
